title: AiDecisionCard input (v1.2.0)
description: Passed to AiDecisionCard.render(input, opts) as an object or a JSON string.

text.description: Plain string, or one string per language code.

bullets.description: Explanation bullets shown in a collapsible region. Omit to hide the toggle.

k.description: Stable machine key returned in the output. Never translated. '__other' is reserved.

s.description: Rating 1-10 shown as a badge: >=8 green ✓, 5-7 amber ●, <=4 red ✕.

id.description: Question key returned in the output.

m.description: Multi-choice (checkboxes). Default false. Selected answers get a details box (comment + attach) behind the left toggle.

b.description: Blocking: an answer is required. Default true.

c.description: Show the 'My own answer' option with a text field. Default true.

n.description: Show a per-question comment box. Default true.

a.description: Attach buttons for this question; on multi-choice questions also inside each selected answer's details box. Default true.

visual.description: Visual shown before a question title or answer label: 'i:<name>' built-in icon (tray, file, zip, save, share, plane, check, reply, note, info, warn, star, mail, db, mic, clip, paste, scr, ext), 'p:<path d>' 24x24 SVG path (sanitised), or an https:// image URL.

id.description: Card id, echoed in the output.

lang.description: Display language code; 'en' and 'he' (RTL) built in. Default 'en'.

title.description: Card title, shown in the card header (and as the page title in the viewer / render.js).

strings.description: Per-language UI string overrides or new languages (must include 'dir' for a new language).

a.description: Card-level attach button next to Summary comments. Default true.

oneOf.description: Viewer page URL for 'Open in browser'.

ref.description: Reference ID shown under the title and echoed as card_ref, e.g. AB_20261027_2310_ADC_TOPIC.

who.description: Multi-user card: the respondent's name/ID is required and goes into respondent + the ZIP name. Default false.

confirm.description: Chat cards: show 'Ready to submit' before sending. Default: only when the card has 2+ questions. The browser page always confirms (file name).
